title: Zugzwang
explanation: Black to move — and that is the problem. On Black's move this loses for Black; if it were White's move, Black would hold the draw. Neither side wants to move here: in pawn endings, who has to move decides it.
conceptHint: Who has to move decides it.

title: Zugzwang
explanation: White to move — and that is the problem. On White's move this is a draw for White; if it were Black's move, White would win. Neither side wants to move here: in pawn endings, who has to move decides it.
conceptHint: Who has to move decides it.

title: The outside passer as a decoy
explanation: Black to move and win. The passed pawn on d5 is far from everything else — push it, and White's king has to walk over to stop it. While it does, Black's king takes the pawns on the queenside.
conceptHint: Use the far passer to pull their king away.

title: Chart a course
explanation: White to move and win. Black's pawn on d6 has no pawn that can ever defend it, so that is where White's king is going — not to the centre, to the target.
conceptHint: The king goes to the weak pawn.

title: The race, and the first queen
explanation: Black to move and win. Count it: the pawn on a3 needs 2, the one on h3 needs 5 — Black queens first, and the new queen covers h8, so White's pawn never promotes.
conceptHint: Count the pushes — and where the new queen stands.
